sw_subject: Credits roll: suite of the game's themes, triumphant then reflective.

Mystery Gift screen.
Title screen: big orchestral main title with a heroic brass call. Original composition; do not quote film themes.
Opening crawl: plays under the scrolling story text after the title screen on a new game, until the fade into the main menu. Theme to be decided; original composition, do not quote film themes.
tech_notes: Plays from the first crawl line to the fade into the main menu; game/src/intro_crawl.c sets CRAWL_MUSIC (MUS_NONE today, so the crawl is silent). The crawl runs about 72 s (28 lines at CRAWL_SPEED 34/256 px per frame, plus CRAWL_END_HOLD 60 frames): write a ~72 s piece or loop it. Skip (YES) calls FadeOutBGM(4), so any bar can be cut. Played once, new game only. The galaxy card before the title stays silent on purpose.
notes: No placeholder: the crawl is silent until this song exists (CRAWL_MUSIC MUS_NONE in src/intro_crawl.c). Then set CRAWL_MUSIC to MUS_INTRO_CRAWL.
